title: WP900 G9 semantic-content causality must exclude direct payload access outside the admitted reentry path

material_observation.claim_strength: G9 correctly requires matched task/pre-state/executor/plan/recipient/runtime context, treatment-blind outcome scoring, same-mechanism DELIVERY/UPTAKE/REENTRY and counterbalanced content crossover.
material_observation.remaining_causal_gap: Those conditions do not by themselves prove that the shared task executor can obtain treatment content only from the admitted reentry-derived state. If the executor, a helper, registry, cache, closure, environment value or resolver can directly dereference candidate_payload_ref/broadcast payload identity or bytes, content-dependent task outcomes can occur while REENTRY is causally irrelevant.
material_observation.causal_consequence: A four-trial crossover may be perfectly counterbalanced, source-bound and treatment-blind at the scorer while still measuring direct payload access rather than semantic information delivered through the GWT reentry mechanism. That would be content causality, but not GWT/J-Space reentry causality.

falsifier_hypothesis: Semantic GWT/J-Space promotion is invalid unless every task-relevant treatment-content read is proven to descend from the admitted DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY lineage, with direct payload/condition side channels unavailable to the task executor and its transitive helpers.
counterhypothesis: Matching executor identity and hiding treatment labels from the outcome scorer is sufficient because no alternate treatment-content path exists. This counterhypothesis is falsified if the executor or any transitive dependency can resolve payload identity/content independently of reentry-derived state.

hard_counterexample.setup: Keep both arms byte-identical in start state, source, executor, plan, recipient, runtime context and reentry mechanics. Before invoking the common executor, place candidate_payload_ref or canonical payload bytes in a registry/cache/environment/closure that the executor can read. Also perform valid DELIVERY/UPTAKE/REENTRY in both arms, but make the reentry-derived semantic value constant or ignored.
hard_counterexample.false_green: The task outcomes still track payload A versus B and reproduce across counterbalanced order positions. A comparator that checks only matched mechanics, matched executor identity and condition-blind scoring can report a semantic-content causal candidate even though the causal path bypasses reentry.

required_discriminator_before_semantic_p: Define a condition-blind executor input ABI that contains the admitted reentry-derived task state but contains no treatment label, candidate_payload_ref, broadcast digest, payload bytes, payload registry handle, trial arm label or condition-specific resolver.
Bind and inspect the exact executor plus transitive helper/config identities used in both arms; any treatment-content resolver outside the reentry-derived input is a fail-closed condition.
Record a reentry-derived semantic-state digest immediately before the executor and bind the executor output to that digest rather than directly to the candidate payload identity.

Add a hard negative that makes reentry-derived semantic state identical across A/B while leaving direct payload identity/content available through a side channel. The discriminator must reject/ABSTAIN even if task outputs differ by content.

Add the converse positive control: remove all alternate content channels, vary only content delivered through the admitted reentry path, and require reproducible content-specific outcomes under the same executor and cloned pre-state.

Where practical, execute the task executor in a fresh process whose serialized input is the entire admitted ABI; do not inherit treatment-bearing globals, closures, environment variables or mutable registries.

Keep semantic_gwt_runtime_credit=0 and jspace_runtime_credit=0 until an exact-source owner-VPS execution proves this no-bypass invariant together with G9's matched-state/executor and content-crossover invariants.
scope_fence: This candidate does not invalidate accepted WP900 G7/G8 mechanism/runtime evidence and does not mutate the active G9 claim. It only blocks promotion from a content-correlated task outcome into semantic GWT/J-Space causal authority when an alternate treatment-content path remains possible.
next_exact_action: G9 owner should absorb this as a no-direct-payload-bypass invariant and regression before repository acceptance. The target-runtime discriminator should pass treatment content to the common task executor only through a fully serialized condition-blind reentry-derived ABI and preserve all semantic GWT/J-Space credits at zero until exact execution proves that causal path.
